disposition_mapping.rationale: The council largely converged (maximalist, finance_domain, agentic_architect, hitl_designer, with pragmatist and accounting_standards conceding) that extraction is mechanical retrieval from a governed, already-locked source and that two separately-timed human pulls add no control value once the lock-gate and version checks are explicit and hard-failing rather than advisory. VAR-R-01 is satisfied because the merged step still consumes and gates on locked-period actuals, logging the check rather than relying on an implicit assumption. Per emerging_economy's non-negotiable, the displaced extraction labor is named explicitly (exception-handler/validator), not silently absorbed.

Comparative loading shares the same trigger (period-lock event), the same platform, and the same low-judgment profile as actuals extraction. finance_domain's and pragmatist's concession that version-identity (approved budget, latest forecast) can be guaranteed by an explicit, logged binding rather than a separate named box is adopted: VAR-R-02's required inputs survive as hard-gated, version-tagged fields in the merged ingestion step, satisfying the requirement more rigorously than two independently-timed manual pulls would.

The arithmetic of price/volume/mix decomposition is rules-based and is automated per the near-unanimous council view, but the step remains distinct and is not folded into threshold selection (pragmatist, finance_domain, accounting_standards all insisted a controller must see the variance number before materiality logic touches it). VAR-R-05 and VAR-R-06 are satisfied by requiring explicit, machine-checkable policy-version and FX-table-version lineage on every output record (agentic_architect's and hitl_designer's refinement), and KB-07/KB-08's FX-isolation requirement is hardened by making FX effect its own labeled output field rather than an implicit attribute, per accounting_standards' and agentic_architect's shared concession.

This is the council's central, unresolved conflict: maximalist argued for a pure deterministic rule engine with no standing human discretion, while hitl_designer, finance_domain, agentic_architect, pragmatist, emerging_economy and accounting_standards all independently held that materiality is a judgment-bearing gate (qualitative overrides, borderline aggregation) whose full automation would hollow out VAR-R-04's actor-separation requirement into a human-vs-config-file non-separation. The synthesis sides with the six-member majority: the mechanical percentage/absolute screen is automated, but a named analyst retains override authority with a logged rationale (override log), and that analyst's identity is access-control-enforced as distinct from the TS-06 reviewer, satisfying VAR-R-04 substantively rather than trivially.

Unanimous across the council: causal explanation of variances requires business context and accountability no model possesses, and commentary must remain human-authored and attributable to a named budget holder. The redesign is confined to mechanism — structured root-cause taxonomy, deadline/escalation discipline (finance_domain), and asynchronous/low-bandwidth-capable channels (emerging_economy) — not to disposition.

Maximalist proposed absorbing drafting into a purely automated, actor-less composition step; pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, accounting_standards and emerging_economy all held that consolidation contains a genuine, nameable act — reconciling that every selected variance has matching, adequate commentary — that is lost if nobody is checking for empty cells or mismatched narrative-to-number pairings. The synthesis sides with this majority: the step remains analyst-staffed and tool-assisted, retaining the completeness check as an explicit act, while adopting agentic_architect's per-claim lineage requirement (conceded by maximalist and accounting_standards) so the draft is reviewable at TS-06.

Unanimous and explicitly required to survive (VAR-R-07). The synthesis adopts hitl_designer's strengthening, accepted across the council: the reviewer must have access to underlying variance data, the TS-03 override log, and raw (not just polished) commentary, and must leave documented challenge notes, so review is substantive rather than ceremonial. Actor separation from TS-03 is preserved per VAR-R-04.

Maximalist proposed folding distribution into VAR-07's authority as a bare release checkpoint. Pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer and emerging_economy all held that distribution runs on its own calendar (board/management cadence) and is a distinct, nameable checkpoint — verifying the distributed artifact matches the reviewed one and logging delivery — that is lost if merged into review's sign-off. The synthesis retains VAR-08 as a distinct step, automating the mechanics (packaged distribution, delivery logging, version-hash confirmation) while keeping a lightweight channel as a non-negotiable floor per emerging_economy, triggered only by the manager's TS-06 approval event per agentic_architect's non-negotiable.

steps.actor: Automated ingestion pipeline, with FP&A analyst as exception-handler and version-identity validator
steps.description: A pipeline triggered by the period-lock event pulls actuals directly from the closed, locked ledger and pulls the approved budget version and latest forecast from the governed budget/forecast repository, writing both to a version-tagged, logged landing area. The job hard-fails into an FP&A analyst exception queue (not a soft warning) if the source period is not locked, if the budget/forecast pulled is not the approved/latest version, or if completeness checks fail. The analyst's role shifts from manual extraction/loading to exception resolution and version-identity validation; this labor destination is named explicitly so the function is not silently absorbed into 'the system now does this.' A documented manual fallback (human-run extract against the same lock/version checks) must remain operable where the automated connector is degraded or unavailable.
steps.name: Automated extraction and comparative loading

steps.actor: Automated variance computation engine, with FP&A analyst as anomaly reviewer
steps.description: A deterministic calculation engine computes price, volume and mix variances at constant currency immediately after the ingestion gate passes. Each computed variance record carries the accounting-policy-version identifier and the constant-currency FX-table-version identifier used to produce it, and the FX effect is output as its own separately labeled component rather than netted into price/volume/mix. A policy-basis mismatch between actuals and comparatives (e.g., budget prepared under a prior policy vintage) halts the run and is surfaced for disclosure rather than computed through. Stale or missing reference data halts to an FP&A analyst for review; the engine never silently substitutes a default. The computation logic and its lineage tags must be inspectable and locally reproducible, not confined to a single proprietary black box.
steps.name: Compute variances with policy and FX lineage
outputs: Variance dataset (price/volume/mix, separately labeled FX effect, policy-version and FX-table-version lineage tags)

steps.actor: FP&A analyst (identity distinct from TS-06 reviewer)
steps.description: The approved percentage and absolute materiality thresholds are applied mechanically to partition variances into 'explain' and 'no action.' Items within a configurable tolerance band of the threshold, and any item an analyst elects to escalate or exclude for qualitative reasons (e.g., a sub-threshold variance signaling a control issue, or an aggregation of related sub-threshold items), require an explicit human decision with a documented rationale captured in an override log. This step's function is a judgment-bearing gate, not a pure config filter: the human override authority is retained by design. The analyst performing this selection must be a distinct, access-control-enforced identity from the manager performing TS-06, so that actor separation is structural rather than nominal.
steps.name: Select variances to explain (threshold screen with analyst override)

steps.description: Budget holders provide commentary on selected variances using a structured, root-cause-tagged template (price, volume, mix, FX, one-off, timing, other-with-free-text). Collection operates over asynchronous, low-bandwidth channels (structured email/offline forms) as a floor, with richer real-time workflow tooling permitted as an optional layer. Deadlines are tied to the close calendar with automatic escalation to the budget holder's manager on lateness or on commentary that fails a basic adequacy check (e.g., a materiality-sized variance with a one-word explanation). An automated hypothesis may be pre-drafted to speed response, but the commentary remains the named budget holder's own attributable statement, not unattributed machine narrative.
steps.name: Collect and quality-check budget holder commentary

steps.description: Variances selected for explanation and the corresponding budget holder commentary are consolidated into a draft report. The FP&A analyst, tool-assisted, performs an explicit completeness check that every selected variance has a matching, adequate commentary entry before the draft proceeds — this reconciliation of narrative-to-number is a distinct accountable act, not implicit formatting. Every sentence and figure in the draft carries a machine-checkable pointer back to its source variance record, policy/FX lineage, and commentary author/timestamp, so the draft is reviewable rather than opaque.
steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report
outputs: Draft variance report (with per-claim source lineage)

steps.actor: FP&A manager (identity distinct from TS-03 selector)
steps.description: The FP&A manager reviews the draft report together with the underlying variance dataset, the TS-03 override log, and the raw (pre-consolidation) budget holder commentary — not merely the polished narrative — so that challenge is substantive: implausible or boilerplate commentary can be kicked back, and materiality calls can be questioned. Instances of challenge or disagreement are documented as a retained evidentiary record before sign-off. This actor must remain a distinct identity from whoever performed TS-03's selection.
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.description: Distribution is triggered only by the manager's explicit approval event from TS-06; no automated channel may fire pre-approval. The approved report is formatted and published via a lightweight channel (document/email) as a non-negotiable floor, with a dashboard/BI presentation layer as an optional addition. Delivery logs the recipients, timestamp and version hash, confirming the distributed artifact is exactly the reviewed one (no silent post-review re-editing); any post-distribution correction is a tracked reissue, not a silent edit. Follow-up questions raised on distribution feed into the next cycle's commentary requests.
steps.name: Present, distribute and track distribution
